about.title: Our Story
story: PALMER was born in Mallorca with a clear idea: bring the most advanced technology to homes and businesses in the Balearic Islands with a close, professional, hassle-free service.

We are a local team of technicians and integrators passionate about technology. We combine networks, home automation, audiovisual, document management and photovoltaic energy to design integrated solutions tailored to each client.
We work with the best brands in the industry and care for every detail, from the first visit to ongoing maintenance. Our goal: technology at the service of people, not the other way around.
why: Every project starts by listening. We analyse your real needs and how you live and work to propose truly tailored solutions.
We coordinate every technical discipline under a single project: networks, home automation, AV, document management and PV. One point of contact, zero friction between trades.
We use open platforms and consolidated standards (KNX, Loxone, Ubiquiti, Sonos, Microsoft 365, Huawei, Victron…) so your installation is scalable and long-lasting.
We offer ongoing maintenance and remote monitoring, so we detect and solve incidents before you notice them.
